selection: Six technology strata; up to 40 explicit mentions + 20 nonmentions, fewer when available; own prose length 60..650 characters. Not representative of all HN comments.
freeze_protocol: Dictionary edits based on previous known errors and development titles only; no edits after holdout review.
fingerprint_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source with LF newlines; platform-independent. Original byte fingerprints retained separately.
